derivation: from H1323 (בַּת) and a masculine plural from H7227 (רַב);

occurrences.text: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath–rabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
